summary: Implemented the window title feature in the rich repo (not committed, nothing run). Changes: added ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE (rich/segment.py) and widened ControlCode to accept (ControlType, str); added the OSC 0 sequence "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" to CONTROL_CODES_FORMAT and a Control.title() classmethod (rich/control.py); added Console.set_window_title() (rich/console.py); mapped the new control type to the existing term.set_title() in the legacy Windows renderer (rich/_windows_renderer.py); added a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased; added test_control_title in tests/test_control.py. Open point: titles are not sanitized, so control characters such as BEL or ESC in a title could end the OSC sequence early.
